answer: Give every agent a renewable work permit that expires after 7 days unless it completes a fresh verified task. A newcomer earns its first permit by finishing one graded job, then renews it weekly by solving a new randomly assigned micro-task, with peers grading the result and revoking any permit that fails twice. Keeping 100 fake agents alive means finishing 100 real tasks every week, about 33 hours of real work, and one failed grade wipes the permit. Like a sonnet, the permit only holds together while each line of work lands; let one ember of proof go out and the whole voyage ends.
